scope: d4g plan item 10 (DMA HBM<->VM per quadrant) + stack services crossing the die centre line

decisions.hb_dbk: PER QUADRANT, NO RTL CHANGE: ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks_cp already serves exactly 8 banks; d4g gives every quadrant its own 8 banks (vm_quadrant_map), so hb_dbk_SE/NE are new instances of the unchanged master (closed/submitted views reused: hv16_dbk_collar, hv15_dbk_*). Its wd sector field carries quadrant ordinals (see address contract).
decisions.wbk: PER QUADRANT, NEW MODULE ot_hbm_svc_wb_kport_q (quad strap, 16 K ports) over ot_hbm_svc_wb_cutthrough_cdc #(NPC 16, QFOLD 1). ot_hbm_svc_wb_kport unchanged (byte-identical file). Cutthrough default NPC 32 / QFOLD 0 = GEN0 (regression benches + yosys equivalence).
decisions.wbc: PER QUADRANT, NO RTL CHANGE: ot_hbm_svc_wbw_copy NS 4 already feeds 4 kshares; wbc_<S>0 stays on wbk_W, wbc_<S>1 becomes wbc_<E> fed by wbk_E.
decisions.sfault: PER QUADRANT: ot_hbm_svc_stack_fault #(NPC 16, NG 4, ND 8) (new params, defaults = GEN0, yosys-proven equivalent 310/310). Channel pairs (2c,2c+1) never straddle the halves, so the CA rule is quadrant-local; no stack-level coordination needed (fault/status is host-bound observability).
decisions.refcfg: PER QUADRANT: ot_hbm_pc_refresh_cfg #(NPC 16) (existing param, no RTL change). Refresh needs no per-stack coordination: REFpb is per PC, the CA bus is shared only by the pair (2c,2c+1) inside one half, and the refresh phase is a host-programmed value; each quadrant's 16 PCs release on one HBM edge (phases kept as loaded within the quadrant); the W/E release offset = host frame spacing +-1 HBM edge (the release already crosses a 2-flop CDC, so no edge-exact stack phase existed before either; refresh is absorbed at the HBM K boundary). Nothing crosses the centre line, so no R2 host-leaf route is needed.

address_contract.ordinal: a quadrant DMA write-back block = contiguous quadrant ordinals o (29 b) in wb_reserve_base / wd sector [29:0] (bit 29 = 0), stack bits [31:30] unchanged
address_contract.fold: HBM stack-local sector s = fold_q(o) = {o[28:6], q^o[10]^o[15], o[5:0]}; PC = 16q + (o[5:2]^o[9:6]^o[14:11]); bijection onto the half whose PHY hash bit4 = q
address_contract.limits: block total <= 1984 sectors for any alignment (exact max 1985; real span <= 4095 = 12-bit window total) else reserve fault; fold_q(o_end) < 703,125,000 (22.5e9 B / 32) else fault
address_contract.readers: any reader addresses the real sector fold_q(o) (unchanged PHY hash)

timing.wbw_v: same stream edge as the GEN0 master (lockstep checked)
timing.k_side: fold is two XORs before the K pin skid: +0 edges
timing.window: wbw_base = fold(base), wbw_total = real span (computed 2 registered edges after the reserve pin flop, >= 8 edges before any fill start)
timing.drain: 16 PCs per quadrant DMA (two DMAs per stack, was one 32-PC DMA): first 640-sector block fence 614 (W) / 691 (E) stream edges vs 695 for the GEN0 stack bench (tb_hbm_svc_wb_kshare_q baseline, same traffic mix): no compiler fence change needed at the production 640-sector block

f20_targets.note: 105/107 follow the dbk rule tgt = 104+QID (SW0 SE1 NW2 NE3); 128/129 proposed (free in GEN0). H-D4G owns the allocation: host_cp_ingress TARGET_MASK += 105,107,128,129; host_status NT += 4 (dbk_SE/NE cp_configured/cp_active, refcfg_SE/NE ready/active), NF += 6 (dbk_SE/NE cp_fault, refcfg_SE/NE fault, wbk_SE/NE fault)

netlist_binding.wbk_<q>: ot_hbm_svc_wb_kport_q #(WOPEN 0, MUT 0); straps stk (0 S / 2 N), quad (0 SW/NW, 1 SE/NE); w_k_*[16] -> W: vmks_<S>0..3 (port 4k+l), E: vmks_<S>4..7 (port 4(k-4)+l); w_k_rdy/w_k_wr_done from the same kshare lanes; wbw_* -> wbc_<q>; fault -> host_status NF
